description: Test suite for the ArcBufferWriter class in Orleans Serialization system, validating buffer management, page handling, reference counting, and memory safety within unit tests.

classes.name: ArcBufferWriterTests
classes.description: Contains numerous unit tests for verifying the correct behavior of the ArcBufferWriter class, including buffer management, page reference counting, versioning, memory safety, and error handling.

methods.name: MultiPageBuffer_CorrectlyHandlesLargeWritesAndRetrieval
methods.description: Tests multi-page buffer writing, slicing, reading, and copying to ensure correctness.

methods.name: PageBufferManagement_TracksReferenceCountsAndVersions
methods.description: Verifies that page reference counts and versions are managed properly during slice consumption and disposal.

methods.name: ReplenishBuffers_ProvidesSegmentsAndFreesPages
methods.description: Simulates socket buffer replenishing and ensures pages are correctly allocated and freed after use.

methods.name: WriteBuffer_UpdatesLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Checks that writing data updates the buffer length appropriately.

methods.name: PeekSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataWithoutConsuming
methods.description: Ensures peeking returns the correct data without advancing the read pointer.

methods.name: ConsumeSlice_ReturnsCorrectDataAndUpdatesLength
methods.description: Verifies that consuming slices returns the correct data and updates the buffer length.

methods.name: UseAfterFree_ThrowsException
methods.description: Checks that using a slice after unpinning throws an exception.

methods.name: DoubleFree_ThrowsAndBufferCanBeResetAndDisposed
methods.description: Tests double unpinning throws and that buffers can be reset and disposed safely.

methods.name: NewBuffer_IsEmpty
methods.description: Confirms that a newly created buffer is empty.

methods.name: WriteEmptyBuffer_DoesNotChangeLength
methods.description: Tests that writing an empty buffer does not change the length.

methods.name: PeekEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Verifies peeking into an empty buffer returns empty segments and throws on overreach.

methods.name: ConsumeEmptyBuffer_ReturnsEmptyAndThrowsOnOverflow
methods.description: Verifies consuming from an empty buffer returns empty segments and throws on overreach.

methods.name: DisposeSliceAfterFullPageConsumption_IncrementsPageVersion
methods.description: Checks that disposing a slice after consuming a page updates page version.

methods.name: PageVersionIncrementAfterWriteAndReadHeadAdvance
methods.description: Verifies page versioning correctness after writes and head advances.

methods.name: DisposedBuffer_ThrowsOnAllOperations
methods.description: Checks that disposed buffers throw ObjectDisposedException on operations.

methods.name: DoubleDisposeArcBuffer_IsSafe
methods.description: Ensures double disposing slices is safe.

methods.name: ResetAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Confirms resetting a disposed buffer throws ObjectDisposedException.

methods.name: AdvanceWriterNegative_Throws
methods.description: Verifies that advancing writer negatively throws an exception.

methods.name: AdvanceReaderNegativeOrTooLarge_Throws
methods.description: Checks that invalid AdvanceReader calls throw exceptions.

methods.name: ResetReleasesAllPages_EmptiesBuffer
methods.description: Verifies Reset clears all pages and empties the buffer.

methods.name: DisposeMultipleTimes_IsSafe
methods.description: Ensures multiple calls to Dispose are safe.

methods.name: WriteAfterDispose_Throws
methods.description: Checks that writing or getting memory after dispose throws.

methods.name: PinUnpinReferenceCounting_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies the reference counting behavior on pages during pinning and unpinning.

methods.name: UnpinWithInvalidToken_Throws
methods.description: Ensures unpinning with invalid tokens throws.

methods.name: CheckValidityWithInvalidRefCount_Throws
methods.description: Checks that page validity checks throw if the ref count is invalid.

methods.name: SliceDispose_DoesNotAffectOriginalBuffer
methods.description: Verifies disposing a slice does not impact the original buffer.

methods.name: UnsafeSlice_DoesNotPinPages
methods.description: Ensures UnsafeSlice does not increment page reference counts.

methods.name: CopyToWithInsufficientDestination_Throws
methods.description: Checks that copying to too small a span throws.

methods.name: ConsumeMoreThanAvailable_Throws
methods.description: Ensures consuming more data than available throws.

methods.name: SkipAdvancesReadHead_WorksCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies that skip advances the read head.

methods.name: LargePageReuse_Works
methods.description: Tests that large pages are reused correctly by the pool.

methods.name: MinimumPageReuse_Works
methods.description: Tests reuse of minimum size pages.

methods.name: BoundaryValue_SlicePeekConsume
methods.description: Checks boundary behaviors for slicing, peeking, and consuming.

methods.name: DoubleFree_And_UseAfterFree_Guards
methods.description: Verifies that double free and use-after-free are guarded against.

methods.name: NoMemoryLeak_ReferenceCountReturnsToZero
methods.description: Ensures no memory leak by verifying reference counts reset after disposal.

methods.name: EmptyAndFullBuffer_SlicePeek
methods.description: Tests correct behavior for empty and full buffers during slicing and peeking.

methods.name: SliceAtEnd_ReturnsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that slicing at buffer end returns empty.

methods.name: MultipleSlices_SamePage_NoLeak
methods.description: Verifies that multiple slices referencing same page do not leak memory.
